headline: The autopilot learned to build — SPIRE now lands all four
lede: Stage 2 of the BUILDER arc (#3866): the solver's search space gained plank roads. The attract demo on THE SPIRE now lays the full 12-plank cargo down the east face and brings every lemming home — the tutorial board retired all three deaths it used to take — and THE MASSIF proves wood load-bearing with a four-plank trench road.

notes.text: candidates() offers BUILDER at exactly the cells the sim lays wood — one-tile descent plus solid shelf, so ponds and deep holes can never even be proposed; pinned at proposal level, not just commit.
Massif retrofit: trench cols 37-40 over steel, steel west lip, exit raised, bombs gone — dig still tunnels, but four planks walk the crowd across. proves dig+build; removing the offer reddens 9 pins.
Attract-restart races: road pixels must be sampled inside the drive loop during the laying window — post-win captures flaked until the sampling moved mid-lay.
lemcheck 249, lemplay 55 x2, mutate 270, recmethods 37, lint trio and build clean; prod bundle verified carrying proves dig+build and the byte-identical regenerated rec.
